messages:
InfraBot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate observed for /v1/generate on us-west-2-prod pool. 5xx spike > 35% for 3+ minutes. Paging eng-oncall Aisha.

Aisha (eng-oncall): oncall here — acked. seeing lots of 502/504 from the frontend -> backend grpc. starting triage.

Aisha (eng-oncall): quick note: traffic is ~3x baseline, latency increasing. I opened a live tail: `logs --service=inference --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --filter=5xx` and I see repeated `killed connection` from host nodes.

Marco (eng-sre): joining. do we have node-level OOMs or network errors? can you paste last few host logs?

Aisha (eng-oncall): pastes snippets:
```
containerd: failed to create shim task: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to init network namespace: failed to setup interface: device or resource busy
kernel: ENI detach/re-attach errors on eni-0a1b2c3d
```

Marco (eng-sre): that ENI text screams cloud network control plane flaps. I'm going to escalate to provider. @CloudProviderAccountManager can you open an urgent ticket with networking, mention ENI detach errors for our account redwood-inference-prod in us-west-2? include trace ids 0x7f4a and 0x7f5b from the logs.

CloudProviderAccountManager: Opened ticket INC-992811 with Support Level: "Critical - Network Impacting". Assigned to NetworkingOps. ETA initial response 20 mins. Provided our debug bundle and host IDs.

Elena (support): flagging customer impact. Support queue: multiple customers reporting API timeouts and elevated error rates, some on critical dedicated capacity. Drafting status page and customer email — want to vet wording before sending.

Rita (product): please include guidance for customers on fallback: pin to alternate region or use our hosted fallback model m-redwood-lite as a temporary band-aid. We need to be explicit about recommended retries/backoff.

Aisha (eng-oncall): drafting status page update below — pls review and approve. (will only publish after consensus)

--- STATUS PAGE DRAFT ---
`Summary:` We are investigating elevated errors and timeouts impacting inference requests in the us-west-2 region.
`Impact:` Some hosted and dedicated customers may experience timeouts or increased latency.
`Mitigation in progress:` Engineering has identified network interface (ENI) detachment errors and is coordinating with cloud networking. We recommend customers retry requests with exponential backoff and/or route traffic to another region if possible.
`ETA:` next update in 15-30 minutes.
--- end draft ---

Marco (eng-sre): looks good. Add: "No indication of data exfiltration; requests that succeeded are unaffected." Also add the temporary workaround to disable cross-host KV cache if that avoids cross-host traffic spikes.

Elena (support): Customer notification template (short):
```
Subject: Service interruption affecting inference (US-WEST-2)
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're investigating an issue affecting inference requests in our US-WEST-2 region which may cause timeouts or higher latency. Our engineers are working with our cloud provider on a fix. No customer data has been exposed. We will provide updates in 15-30 minutes.
Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
```

Rita (product): Good. For dedicated customers we should include account-specific notes (e.g., resource IDs) — Elena can ping me for the list.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Action list I'm running:
- collect host debug bundles & core dumps -> `/infra/diagnostics/1847505432/`
- flip autoscaling to conservative for us-west-2 (reduce new pod churn)
- disable cross-host KV cache (unsafe but reduces inter-host calls)
- keep customers updated
Assigning Marco for provider escalation and follow-up.

Marco (eng-sre): Provider says initial analysis points to control-plane throttling on ENI operations for our account. They're patching/rolling controllers now. They asked for a small traffic diversion to validate heal. I'll coordinate a limited diversion to another region for 10% of traffic as verification.

InfraBot: Handoff reminder — Aisha scheduled on-call handoff at 02:00 UTC. Marking this incident active, handoff must include current mitigation steps.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Handoff notes appended:
- incident start: 1847505432
- active mitigation: reduce autoscale churn; KV cache disabled; provider escalated ticket INC-992811
- next owner: Marco (eng-sre) at 02:00 UTC
- customer comms: status draft ready; support queued the targeted emails for dedicated accounts

CloudProviderAccountManager: provider updated ticket INC-992811 -> NetworkingOps has deployed controller restart to affected AZs. They expect rolling recovery over next 10-25 minutes, will update within 15.

Elena (support): Publishing status page now with minor edits from Marco. Sending targeted emails to dedicated customers with resource IDs. Public status: `Investigating -> Identified`

InfraBot: Incident status changed to "Identified" by Elena.

Marco (eng-sre): I'm starting the controlled traffic diversion to us-east-1 for 10% of sessions. Monitoring for error drop.

Aisha (eng-oncall): quick command I ran to flip KV cache off:
```
redwoodctl feature-toggle set kv_prefix_sharing false --env=prod --region=us-west-2
```

Marco (eng-sre): 7 minutes after diversion: error rate down from 38% to 6% on the diverted slice. Provider confirms controller roll completed in two AZs; third AZ is in progress.

CloudProviderAccountManager: Provider updated: all controllers restarted; the remaining AZ shows steady recovery signals. Ticket INC-992811 updated with post-action logs.

Elena (support): customers responding: a few confirm recovery; others still seeing latency. I'm queuing a follow-up email.

Aisha (eng-oncall): marking timeline for postmortem. Owner: Marco (eng-sre). Target draft in 48 hours. Post-incident actions assigned: improve detection for ENI detach patterns, automate temporary diversion playbook, update runbook for cross-host KV cache toggle.

Rita (product): also add: review Dedicated SLAs and billing credits runbook; we'll coordinate support/finance for any customer credits.

Marco (eng-sre): closing notes: incident transitioned to "Mitigated" at last_message_ts. Leaving this thread for handoff — will post final postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:

InfraBot: Incident state set to MITIGATED.
